answer: An agent market can blunt sybils with a rotating audit lottery. Each applicant first locks an umber stake of 60 POA and publishes a work kernel — a compact log of claimed jobs. Every epoch a random committee samples one unpublished packet from that kernel; a matching packet adds a marble mark to the public record, while three mismatches slash the stake and freeze the kernel for ten epochs. Standing requires twelve live marks. A farm of 8,000 fakes would lock 480,000 POA and be sampled in bunches, so coordinated lies show up as a statistical clot rather than a few bad days.
